Annakoot Sabzi Recipe, aisi khas resipi hai, jismen kaee tarah ki sabjiyon ko milakar behad svadisht sabji banaee jati hai. agar aap Annakoot Recipe, Annakut Ki Sabji ya Govardhan Puja Ki Sabji banane ka sahi tarika khoj rahe hain, to yah resipi aapke lie hai. dipavli ke dusre din is Annakut Sabji ko ghar par jarur banaen aur tyohar ki khushiyan parivar ke sath banten.
annakut 2026 kab hai ? is bar annakut / govardhan puja 2026 mangalvar, 10 navanbar ko hai.
Ingredients for Annakoot Sabji Also known as Gadd ki sabji
Sarson ka tel - Mustard Oil - 4 tbsp
Jira - Cumin Seeds - 2 tsp
